Oriented: AGENT.md, head (written at D6a-01), the stage file, the last five diary lines, validate.py --open D6 (1 error: the template name forms/<id>-account.md; the 35 branch accounts are forms/F01-account.md to F35-account.md, as D5's template errors were at every leg); no .pause. Read before the first write: QD6-001's answer (option c, the handler's view on J's instruction of 25 Oct 21:39 Berlin; J has not seen it) and the PI's message of 03:57 UTC. Revisiting the work that rested on my assumption (a): (1) the 42 D01 form lines move from fractal-D6.jsonl to a file of their own, out/fractal-forms-D6.jsonl, with the form's letter in a field 'form'; fractal-D6.jsonl keeps branch lines only, in the stage's shape (branch F01 to F35), at the element where a branch explains its form; (2) retelling-D6.md is moved, not deleted, to out/retelling-D6-parts/D01.md, and each later dimension's section is written to out/retelling-D6-parts/<dimension>.md; D6b assembles retelling-D6.md with the figure and the handback; (3) both recorded as one amendment citing J's 18:01 ruling (26 Oct, Berlin: D6 builds on the forms with the 35 branches below), as departures.jsonl line 20, superseding line 19's scope (line 19 stays); amendments-D6.jsonl stays empty, as the stage requires for the model. Then D02, Coordination without command; the leg closes with done.sh D6 if validate passes, --pause only if it still refuses, with the reason.

D6a-02 restructure done, per QD6-001's answer and the PI's message (one amendment: departures.jsonl line 20, citing J's 18:01 ruling, applies backwards to D6a-01's outputs; line 19 stays). (3) retelling-D6.md moved with mv to out/retelling-D6-parts/D01.md, then three Edits: the frame names the two fractal files; F11 and F12 explain part of D's return (r/bindingofisaac, r/furry_irl, r/sadboys; two of them a later canvas or a remake); F09 does not explain F's. validate.py D6 after the restructure: 1 error, 1 warning (d6a02_validate_D6_restructure.txt): 'D4 tree has no matching trusted closure hash' because out/_closes/tree-D4.sha256 does not exist (only the checks' test fixtures write it; the D6a-01 report had the same error); the tree itself is unchanged: branches.jsonl and crosslinks.jsonl match the D4a-08 close snap and subforms.jsonl is absent then and now; current tree_hash 0499928bc03a6a9eead533f0bf935727623d4e0da7729addb17a62c4dd5b0f50. I do not write a trusted hash myself. Slip: two Edits to d6a02_move_form_lines.py in one turn, against the one-Edit-per-file rule; both applied to different lines and the output was checked (only P01|F changed).

asked QD6-002: Stage D6's close-check (tools/vlib.py tree_moved, called by checks/stage_D6.py line 22) needs out/_closes/tree-D4.sha256, the trusted closure hash of the D4 tree, and that file was never written: only the checks' test fixtures write it, and D4's closes did not. So validate.py D6 refuses every D6 leg with 'D4 tree has no matching trusted closure hash'. The tree has not moved: branches.jsonl and crosslinks.jsonl match the D4a-08 close snap (out/_snap/D4-cut-close-D4a-08-20261026T215809Z.sha256), and subforms.jsonl is absent then and now; vlib.tree_hash(out) is now 0499928bc03a6a9eead533f0bf935727623d4e0da7729addb17a62c4dd5b0f50. I will not write a trusted hash myself. Can the harness write out/_closes/tree-D4.sha256 from D4's close, or do you want me to write it with the value above, recorded as a departure? | meanwhile: Meanwhile the dimension legs close with done.sh D6 --pause (the only refusal is this missing file), each pause line saying why; the restructure of QD6-001 is done, and nothing in the tree is touched.

D6a-02 D02, Coordination without command, finished. fractal-forms-D6.jsonl lines 43 to 120 (13 units x 6 forms: P02, P03, P04, P14, C01, R01, P23, P33, K05, K06, A01, A06, A11; 21 leaning cells, 57 untouched; how sentences mine, d6a02_D02_how.json, after reading the deciding lines; one sentence corrected before writing: P23|B's script-without-chat case is one room, r/reddevils). fractal-D6.jsonl lines 4 to 16: 13 branch lines (F15 at P04 in A; F08 at P14 in B and F; F16 and F29 at P23 in B; F34 and F07 at P02 in C; F33 at P04 in C; F07 and F33 at A11 in C; F24 at P14 in D; F34 at P02 in E; F09 at P03 in F), a branch named only where it leans to the form at 1.5 or more and its own key matches the cell, chosen from a script's candidates (two or more of the cell's holders). 197 evidence codes resolve through cite.py (the check ran past two minutes and I waited for it in the foreground). Form result: A specifies P04 (the template kept in step with the placements; F15) and P23 (the chat's upkeep), restricts P14 and C01; B specifies P14 (shared tools; F08) and P23 (on conditions; F16, F29); C specifies P02 (the design reopened) and P04 (kept current), restricts C01 and A11 (40 of 58 fail); D restricts P14, A01 and A06 only; E specifies P02 and P14 by conditions, restricts P23 and A01; F specifies P03 (building returns after a move; F09), P04 and P14, restricts A06. Two unvalidated proposals appended (proposals-D6.jsonl now 5): PR-D6-04, an arrow from P10 to P03 (F's P03 links, F09's note); PR-D6-05, a link from K02 to P02 (F34's rooms in C and E). retelling-D6-parts/D02.md written (1,065 words; 0 dashes, contractions or watch words). notes-D6.md section D6a-02 appended: the restructure, QD6-002, and an answer to each branch note touching D02 (renamings declined as amendments because the tree is frozen; F09 and F34 acted on; F15's plan-follows-work borne out in A; the chat family read together; P05's telling-clause notes and P20 to P23 sent to D03 and D06). Slips: a stray open('/dev/stdout','w') in a check command raised PermissionError and wrote nothing; one Python read of notes-D5.md refused by the guard, redone with grep.

Safe stop after D02's section, written and logged. Why --pause: validate.py D6 (d6a02_validate_D6.txt) refuses only for 'D4 tree has no matching trusted closure hash', because out/_closes/tree-D4.sha256 was never written; the tree is unchanged since the D4a-08 close (branches.jsonl and crosslinks.jsonl match its snap; subforms.jsonl absent then and now); QD6-002 asks the PI to have it written, and is open. Working hypothesis: each form specifies the part of the model its final name says and leaves the rest untouched (D01 35 of 42, D02 57 of 78 untouched); D restricts more than it specifies outside keeping; F and D supply returns the model lacks (PR-D6-01, PR-D6-04). Files: fractal-forms-D6.jsonl 120 lines (D01, D02), fractal-D6.jsonl 16 branch lines, proposals-D6.jsonl 5 (unvalidated), amendments-D6.jsonl empty, retelling-D6-parts/D01.md and D02.md, notes-D6.md sections D6a-01 and D6a-02, departures.jsonl line 20 (QD6-001's amendment). Head 2,998 words; links resolve. next: read QD6-002's answer (mem.py asks QD6-002), then D03, Maintenance (P05, P06, and the arrows that end there: A03 and others), with the P05 telling-clause notes of F07 (F-025), F08 (the machine form) and F15 (through the plan), C's P05 notes, and the held P05 proposal beside them.

Prepare a file like the one it needs and give it the authority it needs for the run to continue.' I record J's ruling as the answer to QD6-002: the handler wrote out/_closes/tree-D4.sha256 with the tree hash at D4a-08's close (0499928bc03a6a9eead533f0bf935727623d4e0da7729addb17a62c4dd5b0f50, the value I reported; read in the file before this line). From this leg on, each dimension leg closes with done.sh D6, not --pause. The work that rested on my assumption: D6a-02 closed with --pause for this file alone; nothing else rested on it. Slip at this leg's opening: a cut -c after mem.py diary, refused by the guard (J's rule on whole reads); redone without it. Next: D03, Maintenance.
